CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2841 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527. Bus nonce: 0d7a0bb6da4025bb503fa9444b697769. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527` or `Fix review: blocked c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 0d7a0bb6da4025bb503fa9444b697769`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2841 c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2841-0d7a0bb6`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEW round 3 of #2841 (topic r10-card-voice, R10-CARD-VOICE), head c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527 (handoff 0fec20feb00e4b4becc74dab1c4636863db5f505, handoff-body 0a32a60ce065849efc8a3d44df623c6486ee555b), bus nonce 0d7a0bb6da4025bb503fa9444b697769. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA, using the FINDER's harness (the study's harness and the finder's tests/card_browser.mjs P9 grid, as the earlier verdicts did), not the fixer's driver alone.
HISTORY: round 1 blocked at 2cfb8b96 (regression: tests / browser, P9 grid). Round 2 delta (review/2841, bus-confirmed) blocked at 11e8075d, class root-cause-detectable, but the CODE passed every check (P9 grid 324 cells, 0 threw, 0 pop-ups outside, null control kills; tests / browser green): the block was the BODY and a MERGE: (1) pr-contract refused "Closes #2506" because 2506 sat in the group's issues and in no group's fixes; roster batch 17 (#2850, merged 11b7a9d7) now wires 2506 into R10-CARD-VOICE's fixes; the fixer was told to keep Closes #2506 only with an item-by-item acceptance proof against the issue body (else "Part of #2506" and a named remainder carry); (2) git merge-tree against origin/main failed on tests/golden/claimed_drift.txt: keep this branch's five coordinator claims AND main's config_flow line, nothing else. Read the round-2 verdict first: git show origin/review/2841:VERDICT.md. Round 2's carries: the phone dialog tooltip at 10.92 px is "Carry: #201"; the carry_audit "1 unrouted" in a prior reviewer's comment is dismissed.
CHECK, the delta since 11e8075d (three-dot diff against the merge base, never two-dot):
1. CODE UNCHANGED OR RE-PROVEN: git diff 11e8075d..head over custom_components, tests/card_browser.mjs and the card harnesses. If the code changed beyond the main merge, re-run HPO_BROWSER_SCOPE=full node tests/card_browser.mjs after tests/plan_view.py at the head and at the merge base and print rc and the PASS/FAIL lines; both round-1 failures must stay gone. If unchanged, say so with the diff stat and carry round 2's evidence.
2. The "Closes #2506" decision: read the issue body (gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/2506). The body tabulates each acceptance point with the file/test that delivers it and a command. RE-RUN at least every command in the table; any acceptance point not delivered by this PR while "Closes #2506" stays is a block (the fixer's own fallback was "Part of #2506"). Run tools/pr/preflight.sh against the live roster: Closes #2506 must now pass (rc 0); the control is main before batch 17, 4018435-era roster, optional.
3. claimed_drift: git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main head exits 0; tests/golden/claimed_drift.txt keeps the five coordinator claims AND config_flow and nothing else changed; claims-for equals VERSION; python3 tests/env_drift.py passes (a fixture is never both claimed and may-drift); VERSION, manifest and RELEASE_NOTES untouched; dev/programme/delivery/2841.md is in the three-dot diff.
4. python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2841: 0 unrouted for the body. The roster carries of R10-CARD-VOICE (read them from dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json at origin/main; there are six) were answered at round 1: re-open one only if the delta changes its answer.
5. CI at the head from the check-runs API: name every red. The gate and pr-contract are green at c32202c9 as of 06:16Z. Reds on the installation rate limit (HTTP 403, RATE-LIMITED, died before any test body) are infra, not findings; tests / nightly-status is main's record-autofix red (batch=$? under bash -e), not this PR's. The body's ## Red checks must name and answer exactly the reds the head shows.
6. Three-round rule: the body is the minimal re-cut; flag only what is wrong, not style. Re-read refs/pull/2841/head with git ls-remote before writing; say if it moved.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. First line exactly "Fix review: merge c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527" or "Fix review: blocked c32202c92dee44a30cef953fa5edf1a94b27e527 <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 0d7a0bb6da4025bb503fa9444b697769". Then sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>"; the rest under "## Evidence" with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return it on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2841-0d7a0bb6. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. No Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer, no claude.ai link in any commit. Name no path under a home directory in the verdict.
